Dear Lord of Ardencaple,

Yesterday, while I was in the forest, I accidentally dropped my precious axe, and its head came off. I am a stranger in this town and do not have much money, so I really need to get this fixed as cheaply as possible. Do you know of a skilled blacksmith who could handle this?

Also, if you have any corn in stock, would it be possible to buy some in exchange for firewood?

Best Regards.
